1_A1_strict_vs_tolerance.interpretation: 8 cases have -1e-9 <= delta < 0. They are floating-point-scale negatives, not scientifically meaningful harm. BOTH rates must be reported; neither replaces the other, and the choice must be declared in the table caption.
1_A1_strict_vs_tolerance.which_is_primary: BOTH — strict and tolerance-adjusted reported side by side

2_A7_A8_all_population_harm.note: Both are ALL-POPULATION counts over 4957, so they are directly comparable to A1's 2115/4957.

4_execution_vs_acceptance.candidate_refinement_execution: R_psi actually ran on the case (the crop was refined). Determined by the router membership only.
4_execution_vs_acceptance.post_safety_acceptance: S_omega allowed the refined mask to REPLACE the global mask. Determined only by the safety decision, evaluated only where execution occurred.
4_execution_vs_acceptance.key_point: A case can be EXECUTED and then REJECTED. Its delta is then exactly 0.0, so it is neither helped nor harmed — it is not a 'harm' and must not be counted as one.
4_execution_vs_acceptance.consequence: n_executed and n_accepted are different quantities and must never be used interchangeably as a denominator.

5_pooled_vs_macro.pooled_definition: sum(delta) / n_executed  — weights domains by case count
5_pooled_vs_macro.macro_definition: macro = (1/4) * sum_over_4_domains( mean_over_cases_in_domain( delta ) ) — equal domain weight
5_pooled_vs_macro.why_it_matters: DEV is unbalanced (ISIC 2173, KUB 1680, KVASIR 592, BUSI 512), so pooled and macro differ. The frozen Phase-28 arm table reports POOLED means; BARR-M1 declares an equal-domain MACRO endpoint. They are different statistics.
5_pooled_vs_macro.reproduction_gate_consequence: The positive control therefore compares SUMS and COUNTS (definition-free), never the pooled mean against a macro mean.
5_pooled_vs_macro.reporting_rule: Label every mean explicitly as POOLED or MACRO. Never mix them in one table without a column label.

6_keyed_join.why: The Phase-25C label file and the Phase-25E membership file are in DIFFERENT row orders (4955 of 4957 positions differ). A positional zip would silently mis-assign the selection flag to almost every case and would still 'run'.
6_keyed_join.required_control: R2 asserts positional equality is FALSE and that the keyed join is one-to-one with zero missing selections.
